9641: Kurumatani Sora, 149cm, made a promise to his mother "I will dominate my first highschool tournament". But as he joins the basketball club after entering Kuzuryū Highschool, he finds out that it's become a stomping ground for delinquents.
10363: Chiaki Hanazono is Kuzu High's point guard. He is very talented in his view of field and often executes difficult and tricky passes that lead to scoring. He is Momoharu Hanazono's twin brother.
49059: Tobi's history is fairly tragic in that he was forced to persevere through incredibly tough times in the past. His passion for the game of basketball is so high that no one can understand it.
49061: Friends with Momoharu, Chiaki, Saki, and Nabeshima. He has a black belt in karate. He loves his friends and now basketball.
71285: The center of the team. His best attribute is the hook shot, he is been practising the hook shot since grade school.
80237: Fuwa plays for the Inter-high top challengers, Yokohama Taiei. He first appeared by challenging Kenji to a 1 on 1 game which he later won. His ball handling skills rival, if not surpassesl that of Kenji's. He is also a very quick and agile player.
